name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Munificent-class star frigate)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Munificent-class star frigate)
description: A B1-series battle droid was stationed aboard Count Dooku's Munificent-class star frigate around the time of the Malevolence Campaign. When General Grievous ended a transmission with Dooku regarding the fate of the Malevolence, this battle droid surmised that Grievous had ended the transmission himself.
